output.summary: A genus of deciduous flowering shrubs occurring across Europe and Asia. These exceptionally hardy plants develop extensive root systems and are used for erosion control and land reclamation. Their edible berries are naturally astringent, sour and oily, and are made into juice, jams and other foods.
output.edibilityNote: Berries are edible but astringent, sour and oily; they may be frosted or mixed with sweeter juice and made into various foods.
